title: Infinitary positive existential normal forms for modules
summary: Let $θ$ be a regular cardinal, $R$ a ring, and $M$ a left $R$-module. We prove that for every ordinal $α$ there is a set $I_α\subseteq M^{<θ}$ of size at most $\beth_α(|R| + θ)$ such that every parameter-free $L_{\infty,θ}$ formula of rank at most $α$ is equivalent in $M$ to an infinitary Boolean combination of cosets $\overline{a} + φ(M)$, where $\overline{a} \in I_α$ and $φ$ is an infinitary positive existential formula of rank at most $α$.
